answer.origin: Yahoo Finance (finance.yahoo.com, published 2026-07-01) reporting NN, Inc.'s late-June 2026 announcement. The exact announcement day is not in the records; the publication date is not a statement date.
answer.note: Covered company is NVIDIA (NVDA); this is a supplier-side lead, not an NVIDIA disclosure. NN, Inc. reportedly announced in late June 2026 that it would add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks. NN says 100% of the new capacity is pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards, and targets US$80-90 million of accretive new business in 2026. Read conditionally: this is a company statement, not an audited result, and it points to NVIDIA-linked rack liquid cooling demand flowing into a contract manufacturer's capacity plan in 2026. It supports a demand-side signal for NVIDIA rack thermal content in Asia; it does not establish NVIDIA as the direct buyer of these awards, nor the volume, price or timing of any NVDA purchase. The Russell Microcap index removal and the third-party NN revenue and earnings projections concern NN's own equity and forecasts and do not inform NVDA's business.
limitations: The source does not name the customers under the multi-year, multi-product awards, so NVIDIA's direct purchase role in the pre-sold capacity is unconfirmed.
The 100% pre-sold status is NN's own statement and is not independently verified in the records.
The US$80-90 million 2026 new-business figure is a company target, not a result or confirmed award value, and its split between NVIDIA-linked and other business is not disclosed.
No capex, ramp timing, or unit volume beyond the 47 machine centers is given, so the scale of rack liquid cooling demand cannot be sized from these records.
The original NN announcement date and document are not in the records; only the Yahoo report of late June 2026 is available.
The NN revenue and earnings projections (narrative and unnamed analysts) are NN-specific forecasts of unknown reliability and do not measure NVIDIA demand.
follow_up: Retrieve NN, Inc.'s original late-June 2026 press release or 8-K to confirm the announcement date, the 100% pre-sold statement, and whether any awards name NVIDIA or NVIDIA-designated customers.
Check NVIDIA's own disclosures (10-Q/10-K, supplier or sustainability communications) for references to liquid cooling rack suppliers in Asia or to Wuxi-based capacity.
In NN's next quarterly filing, check whether new-business awards, ramp timing and the US$80-90 million 2026 target are reported as realized or revised.
Look for independent reports (trade press, supply-chain research, customs or industry data) that corroborate NVIDIA rack liquid cooling volume ramps in 2026.
